title: Apply to join Tartaros.
intro: Fill in the form below and attach a screenshot of your BTD6 profile. Our recruiters will review your application and get back to you within 24 hours.

form.note_placeholder: How often do you play CT? Any experience with competitive teams? Anything else we should know...
